intent: Do a security review of my Express.js API: check auth middleware, rate limiting, input validation and CORS settings.

spec.goal: Get a security review of your Express.js API that covers its auth middleware, rate limiting, input validation and CORS settings.
spec.deliverable: A written security review report of the Express.js API with findings for each of the four areas and recommended fixes.
constraints: Review is limited to four areas: auth middleware, rate limiting, input validation and CORS settings.
The review is of the user's Express.js API code.
Do not add features or make code changes beyond what is needed to describe recommended fixes.
done_criteria: The report assesses the auth middleware and lists any weaknesses found.
The report assesses rate limiting and lists any weaknesses found.
The report assesses input validation and lists any weaknesses found.
The report assesses CORS settings and lists any weaknesses found.
Each finding comes with a recommended fix.
spec.summary: You'd like us to review your Express.js API for security issues in its auth middleware, rate limiting, input validation and CORS settings, and report back our findings with suggested fixes.
